verdict.rationale: Helicone offers a REST API for point queries, an HQL query language for direct SQL access to logged data, and a one-line PostHog export integration, which give some programmatic data-access/export capability. However, no evidence documents a dedicated bulk-export feature to blob storage (S3/GCS) or to a data warehouse (Snowflake/BigQuery) specifically for traces/datasets. Missing for 10: explicit blob-storage export, data-warehouse connector/sync, bulk/batch export tooling or docs beyond point queries and third-party PostHog export.
